activity.role: Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars
activity.notes: A decree of 6 May 1941 appointed Stalin Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars, making him head of the Soviet government. In March 1946 the Council of People's Commissars was renamed the Council of Ministers; ATLAS therefore ends this formal office phase in 1946 and records the successor government office separately.

sources.title: Telegram 922, Moscow, May 7, 1941 — Foreign Relations of the United States
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State historical document reproduces the 6 May 1941 decree appointing Stalin Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars.
